all.src: Short strike by delta 0.30-0.50 and at least 0.5 x the 5-minute ATR(14) away from spot.
Net debit <= $0.60 per unit, and total 0DTE calendar debit <= 0.5% of equity per session ($250 on $50k).

management.src: Profit target +20% of debit, or $0.10 per unit, whichever comes first.
Stop at -40% of debit, or if spot trades through the short strike by more than 0.3 x ATR(5min).

exits.src: HARD RULE: the 0DTE short leg must be closed by 14:30 ET, every session, regardless of P&L or moneyness. No exceptions, no discretion, no 'it will come back'.
